verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents first-party Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for connecting Dialpad with AI tools and agents. That plausibly lets users operate the product through natural-language commands in an AI client, but the evidence is a single overview line with no detail on which operations are exposed. The customer-facing AI voice/digital agents handle end-customer conversations rather than letting users operate Dialpad, so they don't count. Missing for 10: any built-in natural-language command interface in the Dialpad app, documentation of what MCP lets users do in natural language, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
